title: Good,  but  Lettering is NOT Visible Much!
text:
Good, but Lettering is NOT Visible Much!. Update. CONTACTING THE COMPANY FOR RESPONSE.
Thank you for the company who responded to my review. All is good now!

I like this toaster, it is silver and goes with my black and silver decor in the kitchen. It doesn't take up much room, average two-slice toaster. Works efficiently. I did try at the beginning a once slice that didn't toast good on the other side. But, as a use it more, it did seem to work good, both sides.

What I don't like is the lettering. The company claims the lettering is easy to read. NO, it is not easy to read. And, when you have company coming and using the toaster. ....... they can't read the markings either. The font is too small and doesn't stand out against the silver color.

Other than that, I will monitor this closely.

product_metadata.title: Kenmore 40604 4-Slice Toaster with Dual Controls in Red
features: Features 4 wide toaster slots to fit a variety of breads
Defrost, bagel and cancel functions add convenience
2 shade control dials give you customization power with 9 settings
The stainless-steel exterior can be conveniently wiped clean
description: This Kenmore 4-slice stainless-steel toaster takes the work out of your daily breakfast routine. With multiple settings and controls, you can customize your toast, bagel, waffles and more exactly to your liking. From English muffins to jumbo slices of bread, this 1400W toaster accommodates everything with its extra-long slots. Dual controls and 9 shade settings give you plenty of options for a delicious meal. The stainless-steel exterior can also be conveniently wiped clean.
